name: Sums
summary: A notepad that does the math as you type
description:
Sums is a notepad calculator on your shelf. Write notes in Markdown and mix in calculations in plain language: every line that holds math gets its answer in a column on the right.

It understands percentages and VAT, averages, medians and standard deviations, compound interest, variables and units, powered by SoulverCore. Click an answer to copy it.
